fields.description:
## Objective

Replace the demo flow with the full async resolution flow: every click resolves to a Player, Deal-Rep Assignment, and Sign-Up, or is flagged for review with a specific reason. No click is ever lost or hard-failed.

## Implementation Requirements

* Async record-triggered flow per design doc story E-03 and the Miro flow diagram: player resolution (id, external id, then three-email search), player-count branching, player creation with currency derivation, assignment resolution, open Sign-Up collapse, finalization
* Review reasons: Multiple Player Accounts Found; Error Creating Player Account; No Active Deal Rep Assignments Found; Multiple Active Deal Rep Assignments Found; Multiple Sign Up Records Found; Error Creating Sign Up
* Retire the POC demo flow

## Acceptance Criteria

* All acceptance criteria from design doc story E-03
* Bulk test with 200+ clicks covering every branch

## Testing Notes

Branch matrix plus volume test.

## Out of Scope

Backend registration-time push (optional story E-05, client decision).

## Open Questions

* When the only matching Sign-Up for a Player + Deal is already Completed, should a new click link to it or be flagged for review?

---

Estimate: XL · \~48h · Dependencies: POC-12, BUILD-03, backend field contract · Ticket BUILD-04 (approved 2026-07-04)

\[2026-07-30, logged by Claude at Kobi's request — API Spec V2 alignment\]

Deal resolution must special-case partner_external_id = "DIRECT" (required literal per spec v2 — never blank): route the click to the operator's Direct deal (Direct Partner account) instead of attempting a Partner_ID__c match, which would fail against the PTR-{00000} AutoNumber. No Direct deal found for that operator/market/vertical → Review Required, per standard no-match handling.

Also per spec v2 (final 2026-07-30): player matching is external id → three-email search only — phone and name+DOB tiers were removed from the spec, so the ticket's existing description is correct as written.
Hi [@Kobi Kunasekaran](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/profile/1203115293332591)can you confirm if I can start working on this story. It says it is dependent on BUILD-03 (Needs more info)

Updates based on our call this morning: 

* **Player matching**

* First check **external ID**
* If no match, fall back to **email & secondary email (current logic)**
* If there are **multiple matches**, flag for review instead of linking

* **Rep resolution**

* Use the same fallback approach:

* **external ID**
* **email**
* **slug**

* If more than one rep matches, mark for review

* **Deal resolution**

* Prefer **external deal ID**
* If not found, fall back to the other deal fields we discussed:

* state / country
* partner / operator id/name

* If there are duplicates, flag for review

* **Review handling**

* Don’t stop at the first issue
* Collect **all errors/review reasons in one run**
* Store them in the **review reason** field, comma-separated if needed

* **Reprocessing**

* Add a way to **re-run SLC processing**
* Plan was to use a **button** that clears the relevant fields / triggers a blank update
* Only allow this when there isn’t already a related signup assigned

* **Processing behavior**

* If a record is already linked, keep updating **processing status**
* On reprocess, clear **processing status** and **review reason** so it can run cleanly again

* **Implementation note**

* The flow should be able to continue through the steps and fill what it can, rather than failing immediately at the first missing match
